summary: Provenance wiring: Agents creating notes MUST pass wires_to=[current_task_key] in record_decision so the DAG edge is created at note-creation time. Do not rely on cosine autowire — semantic similarity is best-effort and misses structurally important edges. Example: if working task #17, pass wires_to=["17"].
